name: security-research/source-regression
title: Source-only version comparison
description: Read-only source comparison between two revisions: resolve each commit, produce a diffstat, and record a candidate explanation as an analysis-only hypothesis. Proves the research methodology is not Proxmox-specific — it needs only the Git capability and touches no lab. Never modifies the repository.

repo_path.description: Path to a local checkout of the source under research (in the private workspace).

candidate_ref.description: Candidate commit-ish to compare against the baseline.

campaign_id.description: Research campaign the hypothesis belongs to.

title.description: Short title for the recorded hypothesis.

claim.description: The candidate explanation being recorded for later dynamic validation.

steps.name: diffstat
steps.title: Changed files between the two revisions

steps.name: record
steps.title: Record a candidate explanation as an analysis-only hypothesis

args.title: ${inputs.title}
args.rationale: Source comparison ${inputs.baseline_ref}..${inputs.candidate_ref}; see attached diffstat for the changed surface.
